name: Kagura Hazuki
source:
As the elder Kagura sister, she manages an old Shinto Shrine in a nearly deserted town.
Very compassionate and cheerful, however a bit of an airhead.
Not very good at doing housework, so she just leaves up the cooking to her little sister, Uzuki.
Therefore, she is entirely in charge of managing the Shrine offerings and cleaning the temple's floors.
She holds potentially strong spiritual power, though unfortunately lacks the understanding of how to use them properly.

"I-I love Akira! Just as much as how father and mother used to be in love with each other."

Translated from [url=http://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=595585]Getchu's[/url] official character description.
